title: FARA — The Arakan Village Name Archive

licence.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
licence.means: You may copy, share and adapt it for any purpose, as long as you credit FARA.

dataset_files: Every village, one row each: names in three languages, coordinates, village tract, township, district and official place codes.
The same records as map points (villages with a verified position only).
Every change FARA has made to a value taken from its source, with the date and the reason.
How each official place code was matched: method, distance and MIMU's own names.
The records whose place code a person should still look at.
What UNOSAT's satellite analysis of 31 August to 11 October 2017 marked at or near each village.
The same as JSON, with the method and its cautions.
The zones of destroyed buildings UNOSAT mapped in 2017, as outlines.
Counts: villages by township and district, missing names, place codes.
